commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you activate an ability of an artifact or creature that isn't a mana ability, if one or more permanents were sacrificed to activate it, you may copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. (Sacrificing an artifact for mana to activate an ability doesn't count.)

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval of the three current-cycle swaps and exact 100-card approved list; fresh retrospective Oracle/rules gate completed 2026-10-14 with stale Ashnod rules wording corrected separately.

strategy.primary: Artifact-sacrifice engine: activate abilities whose costs sacrifice artifacts or creatures (Spellbombs, Station effects, Trading Post, Time Sieve, altars-as-costs) and copy every one of them with Ashnod, recurring the fodder with Trawler/Retriever/Welder loops.
strategy.secondary: Spellbook infinites around Myr Retriever + Scrap Trawler + altar/KCI + cost reducer, Nim Deathmantle loops and Dross Scorpion + Retrofitter Foundry, with drain payoffs (Disciple, Mayhem Devil, Reckless Fireweaver).

role.advances_plan: Ashnod doubles every non-mana ability that sacrificed something to activate: copied Time Sieve is two extra turns, copied Trading Post is two cards or two artifacts back.
role.honest_note: The source blueprint describes an older 'once each turn, nontoken' Ashnod; current Oracle has no turn limit and tokens count (M1 ashnod-01). The deck is stronger than the source text implies, and its infinites run without Ashnod.

identity_core.why: Copies every sacrifice-cost ability; nothing else in the deck doubles activations.
Approved swap: four sacrifice modes, each doubled by Ashnod.
Copied, it is two extra turns per activation.
Recursion hub of the Retriever loop.
A second copy layer on the same activation.
